t: POLICY: Gardener scans spokes for custom patterns not in framework template — signals validated innovations
description: When gardener runs on a spoke, compare its WAI-Spoke/ contents against the framework template. Files or patterns that exist in the spoke but NOT in the template are potential innovations. If the pattern is validated (used successfully for 3+ sessions), gardener creates a signal-innovation lug and routes to framework for potential inclusion in the template. This makes innovation flow bottom-up: spokes experiment → gardener detects → framework evaluates → template updated → all spokes benefit.
protocol: 1. Diff spoke WAI-Spoke/ against templates/spoke/WAI-Spoke/ (structure only, not content)
2. For each extra file/folder in spoke: check if it's been stable for 3+ sessions (git log)
3. If stable: create signal lug routed to FRAMEWORK with description of the innovation
5. If it's in .gitignore or runtime/: ignore (operational, not innovation)
